narration: Your beneficiary form overrides your entire will. Forty-two percent of Americans have it wrong — and that one blank line is costing families hundreds of thousands.
visual: Split screen: a WILL document with a large red X vs. a glowing BENEFICIARY FORM with a green checkmark. Bottom badge: '42% Have It Wrong' in red.

narration: You got divorced in 2011 and never updated it. Your ex legally inherits your entire 401k — even if your will says otherwise.
visual: A crossed-out gold wedding ring SVG. Arrow from '401k: $487K' to a red person silhouette labeled 'EX-SPOUSE.' Red warning banner: 'Even If Your Will Says Otherwise.'

narration: No beneficiary means probate — 18 months in court and $47,000 in legal fees. Your family waits two years to see a dollar of your retirement.
visual: Courthouse with columns and gavel animation. Two bold red stats spring in: '18 MONTHS IN COURT' and '$47K IN LEGAL FEES.'

narration: Here's the new trap: the SECURE Act forces heirs to drain the account in ten years. That forced income can hit the 37% tax bracket.
visual: Calendar with 10 numbered squares lighting up red one by one. Bold red badge: '37% TAX BRACKET HIT.' Subtitle: 'On money you spent 40 years saving.'

narration: A $500,000 retirement account handled wrong leaves just $120,000 after taxes and probate. That's $380,000 vanished — from a form you never bothered to update.
visual: A red progress bar drains from $500,000 down to $120,000 in real time. Bold stats: '$380K VANISHED' in red and '$120K WHAT HEIRS KEEP' in green.

narration: Log into your retirement account today and update your beneficiary. It takes five minutes. One form protects everything you spent a lifetime building. Don't wait.
visual: Laptop SVG showing 'Update Beneficiary' screen with a green save button. Big green checkmark bounces in. Red CTA: 'UPDATE NOW.' Bottom text: 'Your family can't afford to wait.'
